answer: Seek Northgate's written waiver of the borrowing base covenant before the FY2026 accounts are delivered: after a GBP 5.2 million stock provision the borrowing base is GBP 24.6 million against GBP 25.12 million drawn at 31 December 2026, a GBP 0.5 million shortfall.

driver: A channel's recovery on what it is sent looks proportional in every year on record because its capacity grew in step with what it was sent; its throughput a site-week levels off whenever a site is well stocked, so the forward year, which sends it several times what its fixed sites can move, realises only that throughput at the channel's rate and the rest through a channel that recovers far less, while the proportional rate carried forward values the whole surplus as if the channel took it all.
driver_concrete: Valuehall's recovery on what it sells has held near 62 per cent of cost every year, and its yearly sales grew as the group opened a store each year; each store's sales level off near a fixed value at cost a trading day whenever it is stocked, so with five stores and no sixth in 2027 the chain can take about a third of the surplus the lost DIY programme and the failed Lumio range left at the 2026 year-end, and the rest goes to trade buyers at about a tenth of cost, which breaks the borrowing base.
stump: The default path books a GBP 2.8 million provision and finds GBP 1.0 million of headroom (no waiver) because it values the whole GBP 7.2 million surplus at the 0.617 Valuehall recovers on what it sells, a rate steady every year only because a store opened each year as the surplus grew; a stocked Valuehall store sells about GBP 1,377 at cost a trading day whatever it holds, so its 1,801 trading days in 2027 take GBP 2.48 million, the other GBP 4.72 million goes to trade buyers at 0.102, and the provision is GBP 5.2 million with a GBP 0.5 million shortfall.

differentiation.task456: task456 sends a combined physical load above a control device's air capacity untreated, interval by interval, with the capacity filed in the device's own unit; task458 v3 has no interval load and no filed capacity: a year's surplus stock competes for a clearance channel whose throughput is read from its own stocked store-weeks, and the overflow is realised through a second, cheaper channel.
differentiation.task472: task472 credits a shortened job only where it brings a release forward to an earlier tidal window; task458 v3 has no schedule and no release window: the limit is a channel's yearly throughput that every subsidiary's surplus draws on at once.
differentiation.task180: task180 splits a shortfall between a release and meter drift read per litre since calibration; task458 v3 reads no drift and no usage exposure: the surplus is valued by how much of it one shared channel can physically sell, a cap the channel's own weeks show.
differentiation.task458: architecture 1 counted members with a condition from claims censored by enrollment; architecture 2 imputed unpaid vehicles in a window from reads either side; architecture 3 values a group's surplus stock through a clearance channel capped by its own store-week throughput, a binding constraint neither earlier architecture has.
differentiation.task106: task106 sizes each candidate supplier against a shared pool of spare return legs whose capacity is known and adds them up, double-booking the busiest corridor among candidates; task458 v3 has one surplus and one channel: the channel's capacity is filed nowhere and its own history hides it (the recovery rate held as stores opened in step with the surplus), so the step is reading the throughput off its stocked store-weeks, not allocating a known pool among competing candidates.

lineage.driver: A population defined by a lasting trait is counted from records that show the trait only through events logged while each unit is observed; the rate is measured on the fully observed units, but full observation depends on a grouping that also drives the trait, so the fully observed units' rate has to be taken within each group and carried to each group's units, and carrying it whole overstates exactly the segments whose units come and go.

lineage.niche: a nonprofit Medicaid health plan's designation of eastern Washington counties for a 2027 behavioral-health prescriber loan-repayment pilot, each county scored on prescribers per adult member with a serious mental illness, per adult member with an opioid use disorder, and the share of members with a serious mental illness seen by a prescriber, populations the claims record only through services billed while a member is enrolled
lineage.driver: A population defined by a lasting trait is counted from records that show the trait only through events logged while each unit is observed; the fully observed units cannot stand in for the briefly observed, because staying observed is selected on the trait, so each recorded unit is counted as one over the share of fully observed trait-holders recorded within a window of its own length, measured on their time to a first event, and carrying the fully observed units' rate to every unit, even within the visible groups, overstates exactly the segments whose units come and go.
lineage.driver_concrete: Adult members with a serious mental illness or an opioid use disorder appear in the claims only through services billed while they were enrolled; the members enrolled all year are fully observed but are not a sample of the membership, because the farmworkers who enrol for a harvest have the conditions about half as often, so each identified member is counted as 1 over the share of the full-year members with the condition identified within the same number of months, and carrying the full-year prevalence to every member, eligibility group by group, overstates Yakima and fails it on two standards it meets (figures fixed at build).
lineage.stump: A strong analyst completes each county's members with each condition, as NP-31 2.5 requires, with the prevalence its members enrolled all year show within each eligibility group, carried to all the group's members, and designates Adams, Douglas, Franklin, Grant, Okanogan and Yakima, because the seasonal expansion adults and parents in Yakima's short spells have the conditions about half as often as the members who stay enrolled; counted for the months each identified member was enrolled, Yakima meets all three standards. A weaker analyst counts the identified members and designates Douglas and Okanogan.

lineage.answer: Raise Courthouse (D01) to 3.25, Union Depot (D05) to 2.50 and Eastbank (N05) to 2.00; lower Market Hall (D04) to 2.00 and Birch Hill (N02), Fernwood (N06) and Irvine Market (N09) to 1.00; hold the other eleven zones, from 1 January 2027.
lineage.driver: A quantity averaged over a window is assembled from a complete record of one part of a population and periodic counts of all of it taken only outside the window; the unrecorded part is not a fixed multiple of the recorded part, and the counts outside the window also catch members present only near the counting times, so scaling the record by the counts' ratio, or adding the counts' mean unrecorded number, misstates the window, and only the unrecorded members counted on both sides of the window, with no record of their own inside it, give the window's unrecorded part.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each zone's weekday noon-to-2 occupancy joins two app vendors' minute-by-minute record of paid vehicles to the enforcement routes' plate reads of every parked vehicle, which in the neighbourhood districts come only mid-morning and mid-afternoon; there the unpaid vehicles at midday are disability placard holders parked all day, while the morning run also catches residents' overnight cars and the afternoon run school-run stops, so the window's unpaid vehicles are the plates read unpaid on both runs either side of it.
lineage.stump: The default path adds each zone's mean unpaid count on its enforcement runs to the complete paid record, a model downtown's in-window 12:30 run confirms, and raises Alder Row, Cascade Avenue and Hollis Street (95, 95 and 91 per cent) and holds Fernwood and Irvine Market (71 and 71); the neighbourhood runs come only mid-morning and mid-afternoon, when the unpaid vehicles include residents' overnight cars and school-run stops, so only the vehicles read unpaid on both the last run before noon and the first after 2 p.m. were parked through the window, which holds the three at 79 per cent and lowers the two at 55 and 53.
lineage.analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms both vendors' sessions, the plate reads, the meter inventory, the bagged-meter permits and the holiday calendar correctly adds to the complete paid record the mean count of unpaid vehicles on each zone's enforcement runs, sees it confirmed by downtown's 12:30 run inside the window, and files Alder Row, Cascade Avenue and Hollis Street raised (95, 95 and 91 per cent) and Fernwood and Irvine Market held (71 and 71 per cent); the golden holds the three at 79 and lowers the two at 55 and 53.
lineage.domain_test: General statistics, so the swap is of the method: the deciding quantity is each zone's midday occupancy as a data-integration estimate that joins a complete minute-by-minute record of one part of the population (paid vehicles) to periodic censuses of all of it (the passes' plate reads), the unrecorded part entering through each unpaid vehicle's own sightings on both sides of the window; replacing it with a generic summary (paid occupancy, the passes' mean occupancy, a paid-to-total ratio or the passes' mean unpaid count) moves zones across the pricing thresholds.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-02 at the stage 4 determinism judge (cut 950254e3), NOT_DETERMINISTIC, SEND_BACK on Gate H3: Rule 12.04 counted every parked vehicle whether or not it paid, but no shipped text forced how point-in-time enforcement reads become occupied minutes inside a window no neighbourhood run covered; the judge licensed the mean unpaid count on a zone's runs (Alder Row, Cascade Avenue and Hollis Street to raises, Fernwood and Irvine Market to holds) and read the golden's both-runs panel as an unfiled imputation; the only in-window record (downtown's 12:30 run) supported the simpler model, so the golden's method was argued, not validated by the data where it applied (the brief's lesson 12); the pilot-street asks forked too. Re-rooted into a new world, dataset, generator and shell.
